message: Dear Kuro, Love your bright sweet smile and joyful energy everytime I "meet" you during Ac/healing session. Happy birthday and wishing you a lifetime of happiness and good health. Stay bubbly!! With lots of love, Ma

Heppi Barkday Kuro 🥳 Eventhough Me and I have not met you in person but we feel like you are already a part of our lives. Thank you for being so pawsome and woofderful. Here's wishing you good health! 健健康康，快快樂樂，壽與天齊 😘🥰

Happy birthday Kuro!! You are such a good boy and I hope you had a great day. I'm so glad I got to meet you in 2023, and I am always so happy to see pictures and videos of you from your sister. I hope you eat lots of yummy food!
Happy Birthday sweet Kuro 🩷 Have the most wonderful day filled with lots of love and treats! - Mi, Po, and Fr
Have a pawtastic Birthday Kuro 🥳🥳🥳 May your day filled with treats and lots of love !

Happy Barkday Uncle Kuro! Always happy to see your smiley face! I'll ask my hooman to bring you more snacks whenever she's going to KL okay! Let's meet up again when your jiejie comes back to Malaysia! From Tu, Bo.

Happy Bark-day, Kuro! 🎂 🎉 Even though we haven't sniffed noses yet, I've heard so many pawsome things about you from our moms! Wishing you a day full of belly rubs, yummy treats, and zoomies around the house! Sending lots of woofs and wags from San Diego! Your fur-iend, Al 🐶💛
it's said that black dogs herald meetings with old friends. though we have never met, thank you for reconnecting your mom and i on the other side of the world. happy birthday, kuro!
